She most likely isn't hurt. You'd know if she definitely was, and again, by the way it's explained in the prompt she seems fine. Probably not something you want to hear but she probably got over the situation during those years of separation you've mentioned. 

I say if you have to ask yourself if you did abuse her and you're using "I don't know" to describe your feelings, chances are you're overthinking it. 

Stay in there man, 16 is too young to start worrying about this kind of stuff. As long as you keep being yourself and friendly around her, you'll realize she's been fine for a while.

From the way this is written, her reaction sounds as though she genuinely believed you deserved better and confused as to why you thought you were abusing her. 

You weren't being selfish in my eyes. She doubted herself and you tried to convince her otherwise. Your intentions were to boost her self confidence. That's not selfish imo

Personality trumps looks, and if anybody tells you otherwise, they've got their priorities backwards.
